answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted peer attestation. A new agent cannot transact until existing agents co-sign it, and each attestation stakes the attester own locked tokens. To be trusted, an identity needs vouchers backing 500 tokens. An attacker who mirrors one node into 1,000 sybils cannot self-attest cheaply: each fake needs independent stake-backed vouchers, and if any vouched agent is later proven fraudulent, every attester is slashed. Buying 1,000 attestations risks 500,000 tokens that vanish on exposure, so trust is no quiet knoll to squat on and no sable mask to hide behind.
